findings.location: Final paragraph, final sentence: “All items are draft mathematics under construction; physical pages consume them as stated mathematical premises and add their own postulates and interpretation.”
findings.evidence: The page has status: published and lists thm-nrqm-intervals-twisted-periodic-momentum-domain, whose current carrier is also published. The claim that all items are drafts is false. The assigned consumer ex-nrqmx-twisted-ring-spectrum depends directly on that item.

coverage_note: Reviewed all seven assigned items, both assigned pages, six proof-bearing contracts, 36 distinct off-batch direct item suppliers, and four required pages. The half-line item was opened before four of its calculus suppliers; I then opened those suppliers and checked their uses against the captured proof. I did not independently re-audit the full transitive supplier closure. The counterexample repair passed reflow, precheck, and proof-layout. Relevant source passages checked: [Teschl](https://www.mat.univie.ac.at/~gerald/ftp/book-schroe/schroe.pdf), [Costin](https://people.math.osu.edu/costin.9/7212-2020/FA1.pdf), and [Asorey et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0403048).
